Correct speaker QA constructor contract and retain verified application evidence

Expect faster-whisper's actual default cpu_threads=0 while preserving source-enforced four-CPU launch and all original model, worker, input, acoustic and resource checks. Add five negative runtime controls and a new source-bound hosted plan without rewriting previous plans or failed runs.

Retain completed application/translation/speaker evidence, source-reviewed grammar setup and its original dependency-path failure. Production application files, models, version and release criteria remain unchanged. Focused QA controls: 35 passed; no-model source preflight passed.
